question: What additional types are named in the enumeration addressed to the lord of gods?
premises: One type is identified as the triple-staff bearer.
That other type is the seller of the Veda.
inference: The enumeration further includes the triple-staff bearer and the seller of the Veda.
plain_english: O lord of gods, there is also the triple-staff bearer, and likewise another, the seller of the Veda.
